## Hypothesis

The TRENDLINE_BREAKOUT_VETO candidate aims to capture the edge in vetoing trendline breakout trades when the setup conditions are not met. This is based on the observation that trendline breakouts can be false signals, especially when the breakout is not accompanied by a corresponding increase in volume or when the trendline is not a strong support or resistance level.

## Mechanism

The TRENDLINE_BREAKOUT_VETO mechanism will use a combination of technical indicators and market structure analysis to identify potential trendline breakouts. The veto will be triggered when the following conditions are met:

* A trendline breakout is detected, but the corresponding volume increase is below a certain threshold (e.g., 1.5 times the average volume).
* The trendline is not a strong support or resistance level (e.g., it has not been tested multiple times in the past).
